g.text: A relative is reached when it shares at least 10× more k-mers with the anchor than an organism from another kingdom does, and at least 100 sampled

g.text: Number in each cell: how many times more; 1 in 200 (DNA: 1 in 1000) k-mers sampled.

g.text: Where the other-kingdom species share no sampled k-mer, the cell gives how many the relative shares instead.
